synthetic_population.interpretation: normalized DoRF irradiance to normalized display-intensity Look Approximation

controls.exact_per_channel_monotone: descriptive upper-bound identity with the candidate; never a promotion control

branch_rules.no_structural_survivor: close raw DoRF response route; no clamp, smoothing, neutral gauge, LUT, neural or image rescue
branch_rules.basic_collapse: retain only as a tone/basic-control prior; do not call it a distinct film operator
branch_rules.insufficient_diversity: retain at most one descriptive response prior; do not create a stock bank or router
branch_rules.full_pass: open only a separately frozen AB2 internal Look-Approximation contract; no image render is automatically authorized

forbidden: inspect project photographs before AB1 automatic decision
repair source names or combine incomplete triplets
select candidates or thresholds after seeing AB1 metrics
clamp, gamut-map, smooth, neutralize or refit a failing source curve
fit current real-film pixels, train a model, route by content, or open LSM
claim paired digital-to-film truth, calibrated stock response, spectral/process/scanner identity, or product readiness
claim_ceiling: synthetic structural and diversity evidence for historical normalized per-channel response priors
